sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 23794 of 2024
Petitioner :- Pradeep Sharma

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Krishna Nand

Counsel for Respondent :- Dhiraj Kumar Pandey,G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.
2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing FIR dated 14.03.2024 registered as Case Crime No.0095 of 2024 u/s 376 IPC, P.S. Kotwali Dehat, District-Saharanpur.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has not committed any offence and he has been implicated due to malicious intention.

He submits that the petitioner is innocent person and allegations levelled against him is highly improbable and unbelievable, as such, the Pradeep Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191836524/
1

entities.text: Pradeep Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: impugned FIR is liable to be quashed.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
5. Perusal of the impugned FIR, prima facie, reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs.
Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp.(1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262 of 2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati and another vs. State of U.P.) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned FIR.
